resources.string: Lets Jarvis tap the Send button in WhatsApp after it opens a chat with your message prefilled; it only acts inside WhatsApp, right after you asked it to send a message, and never reads your chats. It also lets Jarvis answer “Jarvis, what is on my screen?”: when you say “Jarvis”, a screenshot is kept in memory for up to a minute and is sent to the AI behind your Jarvis backend only if your question is about the screen. You can turn this off under Settings, Screen awareness.
